name: @tholus/demo
description: A static, framework-free page that runs uv in a terminal and hands the environment to Pyodide

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild dist/main.js --bundle --format=esm --platform=browser --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/main.js --allow-overwrite --loader:.css=text && node copy-libcurl.mjs && node build-site.mjs
